why: The ζ₈ phase does predict the word sign out of sample (train p ≤ P/2, test p > P/2: 91.6% vs 68.9% baseline at P = 3000, 2 554 words), but the sign (A/p) of a word p = tuv − u − v, A = tu − 1, is an exact function of (t,u,v) mod 8 (0 conflicts in 78 classes, p ≤ 1500; Jacobi reciprocity with A ≡ −1 mod u, the slot-lemma pattern), and [a]_q at q = ζ₈ is 8-periodic in each CF digit, so the phase is a lossy mod-8 CF statistic. No new invariant.
